def: plain before all men, i.e. obvious

occurrences.text: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
